'''Enok Galir''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who worked for the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] at their [[CZ-198]] research facility. At Special Executive [[Rasmus Blys]]'s instruction, Galir and his fellows weaponized various creatures, such as [[Flesh Raider]]s from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Galir was horrified by their creations and consumed with guilt, and so he sent a message to his [[Alara Galir's mother|wife]] and his daughter [[Alara Galir|Alara]] begging their forgiveness, as he believed he would not survive to see them again.<ref name="Sorry" />
